resources.string: A call when you need an exit
ExitCall gives you a discreet, scheduled way to step away when a situation becomes uncomfortable.
Schedule an ExitCall for the moment you need it.
Use it as a private exit and safety tool.
Every ExitCall carries one small marker so you can distinguish it from a genuine phone call.
The discreet EC marker stays in a fixed position on ExitCall call screens.
No EC = treat it as a real call
If the marker is absent, assume the call is genuine and respond normally.
Make sure ExitCall can reach you
Android controls how ExitCall can notify you. We only ask for capabilities used by the call flow.
Required. ExitCall cannot deliver a call while notifications are disabled.
Recommended. When unavailable, ExitCall falls back to a high-priority call notification.
Needed only for precise scheduled calls. ExitCall asks for this when you schedule one.
Enable notifications to continue. They are required for ExitCall delivery.
You can learn the flow before deciding whether ExitCall is useful for you.
One onboarding demo is included and never uses a free call.
Two real ExitCalls are included before the one-time Premium unlock.
Answer or Decline uses one free call. A timeout does not. Scheduling or editing a call does not use one either.
Answer the call to hear a calm, guided voice. Hang up when you are ready to finish setup. This demo never uses a free call.
Later, you can record your own voice or import an audio file. Without custom audio, ExitCall uses the default voice. You can review this tutorial again from Settings.
You have reviewed how ExitCall works and how to identify an ExitCall.
Your settings, scheduled call and free-call balance have not changed.
Restore exact-alarm access for the scheduled call.
Notification fallback is active; full-screen calls are unavailable.
ExitCall can deliver immediate and scheduled calls.
Clear information about what ExitCall stores, the Android capabilities it uses and the limits of the service.
ExitCall is designed to work on your device without an ExitCall account or server.
Caller details, call settings, onboarding status and a pending schedule are stored in the app\'s private local storage.
The app does not request Internet access and does not upload your data. Android may include app data in a device backup according to your system backup settings.
Choosing a contact uses Android\'s single-phone picker. ExitCall does not request broad access to your address book.
Notifications deliver calls. Exact alarms are used only for precise schedules. Full-screen access improves presentation but has a notification fallback.
ExitCall creates a simulated incoming call to help you leave an awkward or uncomfortable situation.
The EC marker identifies an ExitCall. If EC is absent, treat the call as genuine.
Android and device power settings can affect delivery. Test ExitCall on your device before relying on it.
ExitCall is not an emergency service and cannot contact police, medical services or another person for you.
